# wedos_dns_zone (Resource)

A primary DNS zone in WEDOS DNS. Deleting the resource deletes the zone with all its records.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "wedos_dns_zone" "example" {
  name = "example.cz"
}

output "name_servers" {
  value = wedos_dns_zone.example.name_servers
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Zone name, e.g. example.cz.

### Optional

- `axfr_ips` (Set of String) IP addresses allowed to transfer the zone (outgoing AXFR). Unset disables AXFR.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `name_servers` (List of String) Authoritative name servers assigned by WEDOS; use them for the delegation at the registrar.
- `status` (String) Zone status reported by WEDOS, e.g. active.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A zone is imported by its name.
terraform import wedos_dns_zone.example example.cz
```
